svg.aria-label: Mirage over S3, Slack and Google Drive, the gh, linear and deepwiki-mcp CLIs, three VMs and a policy layer: a grep searches all three filesystems, the three CLIs feed one grep and one pipeline runs across Monty, an E2B sandbox and an EC2 GPU, and one line that reads a hidden .pem key, deletes from the read-only /s3 mount and merges a PR is refused by policy before any of it reaches a service.
